executive_summary: This document argues that the K variable (Love) is the canonical attractor that resolves the tension between Grace and Truth in the Master Equation. It presents a structural claim that Love is not merely an emotion but a fundamental force that harmonizes the opposing poles of Grace (unconditional acceptance) and Truth (absolute standards). The key evidence is drawn from the Master Equation framework, showing how K acts as a mediating variable that prevents the system from collapsing into either extreme. The conclusion is that Love is the ultimate balancing principle, making it essential for understanding the dynamics of the Theophysics model.
